Alt text: "Text description about astigmatism. It explains that astigmatism is a vision condition causing blurred vision due to the irregular shape of the cornea or lens. The cornea is not fully circular but shaped like a football. Astigmatism makes it difficult to see fine details, either close up or from a distance, and can cause symptoms like blurry vision, eyestrain, tired eyes, or headaches. It can be corrected with eyeglasses, astigmatic contact lenses, or laser surgery."
